verdict.rationale: New Relic AI is documented as a first-party feature letting users 'ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language,' and the MCP server explicitly converts plain-English questions into NRQL queries, enabling natural-language operation of core observability workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI assistant's reliability and broader coverage of natural-language control over configuration/alerting actions beyond querying and troubleshooting.
